confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'the issue likely lies with the heater element, its thermal cut-out or the thermostat' is hedged and reasonable

rationale: The assistant steered sensibly through programme, filter and vent checks, then correctly escalated to an engineer without recommending a part, which suits a customer with no multimeter. Weaknesses: the final message is brief, did not link the clogged-hose history to a likely one-shot thermal cut-out, did not ask for the full model number from the rear label, and did not warn against bypassing cut-outs. Also, the early turns offered some generic or irrelevant advice (heat-pump filter) and mildly repeated the unplug instruction, though no real looping occurred.
